This is pro-democratic rhetoric, but it is general and not proof of durable strengthening.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.1","4B.3","4B.7"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged protesters’ legitimate hopes, asked them to suspend demonstrations for dialogue, and told law enforcement to protect lives and property responsibly. It does not, by itself, prove stronger democratic resilience.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.5","4B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House said Nigeria’s media environment is impeded by criminal defamation laws and frequent harassment and arrest of journalists covering politically sensitive topics.
